name: Veet Professional Dry Skin Hair Removal Wax Strips 20 Strips for Body & Legs
description:
Product details of Veet Professional Normal Skin Hair Removal Wax Strips – 20 Strips / 8 Strips (Body & Legs)

Product Type: Hair Removal Wax Strips

Quantity: 20 Pre-Coated Wax Strips + 4 Perfect Finish Wipes

Suitable For: Normal & Sensitive Skin

Key Features:

Gentle & Effective: Removes hair from the root for smooth skin

Ready-to-Use: Quick and easy hair removal at home

Enriched with Almond Oil: Nourishes and softens skin

Cornflower Scent: Pleasant aroma during use

Easy-Gel Technology: Flows around and actively grips even short hairs without sticking to skin

Up to 28 Days Smoothness: Long-lasting results

Convenient & Easy to Use: 3 simple steps – peel, apply, pull

Professional Results: Provides first-time confidence with salon-quality finish

Additional Wipes: Perfect Finish Wipes to remove residue and leave skin soft
